Jana (PM): Morning — quick sync. We need to lock Q2 scope for the Optimize kit. Several customers pushing for batching + caching + quant recommendations + eval-triggered alerts. I want to propose a reduced Phase 1: advisor + two pilot integrations. Quick takes?

Eric (Eng): +1 to scope reduction. Main risk is we accidentally touch serving hot paths with caching/batching changes. If advisor is read-only (suggests configs) it's much lower risk.

Maria (ML): Alerting is high value but noisy if we don't nail signals. MVP alert types I'd prioritize: 1) per-prompt accuracy regression, 2) P95 latency regressions, 3) token-cost anomalies.

Tom (SE): For quant recs let's ship presets first (e.g., safe INT8, conservative FP16) and a recommended fallback model. Auto-quant + tuning can be Phase 2.

Priya (CS): FYI customers Alpha & Kanga asked specifically for per-route caching recommendations and a guided rollout doc. They're willing to do evaluation sessions during pilot.

Jana (PM): Draft proposal for Phase 1 (6 weeks):
- Advisor CLI + minimal Dashboard view (read-only recs)
- Two static recommendations: batching size heuristic + quant preset chooser
- Eval-triggered alert hook that sends structured events to eval-sentry/webhook (opt-in)
- Pilot onboarding + runbook
Can we deliver without infra-scale work?

Eric (Eng): Yes if we output recs as config suggestions and do not change runtime batching behavior. For alerts, integrate with existing eval-sentry webhook; add an opt-in flag so hosted endpoints don't get extra overhead by default.

Maria (ML): On thresholds: recommend a rolling 7-day baseline and require either >3 std dev change OR an absolute delta threshold to reduce noise. Example rule we discussed:
```json
{
  "alert_name": "per_prompt_accuracy_drop",
  "baseline_window_days": 7,
  "min_requests": 50,
  "condition": "(current_rate < baseline_rate - max(0.03, 3*baseline_std))",
  "notify": "eval-sentry-webhook"
}
```
This keeps alerts actionable for low-volume prompts.

Tom (SE): Ops note: advisor outputs should include a recommended rollback action and a fallback model key so customers can automate quick remediations. Also add a short TTL for cached recs.

Jana (PM): Acceptance criteria for Phase 1 (proposal):
- Perf: advisor enabled causes <5% overhead on hosted endpoints (measured p50/p95).
- Noise: alerts produce <=5 false positives/day per pilot customer during trial window.
- Adoption: 2 pilot customers complete onboarding and provide signoff.
- Documentation: onboarding guide + runbook published.
Any other gates?

Priya (CS): Add: a one-pager for sales + a pilot feedback template. Also require a quick training call for each pilot.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: optimize-advisor/phase1 -> staging at 2024-06-10T18:00Z :rocket:

Eric (Eng): I'll break work into three PRs: advisor-backend (rec generation), advisor-ui (dashboard read-only), eval-webhook-integrations. Will post tickets + rough ETA by EOD.

Jana (PM): Great — Eric, please post a short RFC with the Phase 1 slices and resource asks by EOD. I'll loop in sales & solutions for pilot invites.

Tom (SE): Ack. Will add fallback model examples for the docs. :thumbsup:

Maria (ML): I'll draft the default alert rules and a baseline calc notebook for the pilot datasets.

Priya (CS): I'll draft the sales one-pager and pilot template.

Jana (PM): Thanks team — small scoped Phase 1 feels safe and valuable. We'll reconvene after RFC.
